lines.zh: 我从屋子这头走到那头。
lines.en: I walk from one end of the house to the other.

lines.zh: 我抱着一篮东西，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I carry a basket with light steps.
I make a round of the yard.
I count things as I walk.

lines.zh: 门口的垫子被我摆正了。
lines.en: I straighten the mat by the door.

lines.zh: 我走去灶台那边看看火。
lines.en: I walk over to check the stove.
My steps are not fast, but they do not stop.
I call into the house.
I set the bucket by the door.
I pace along the porch.

lines.zh: 我顺手把地上的东西收好。
lines.en: I tidy what is on the floor as I pass.
I bend to pick up a fallen leaf.
I go and bolt the door.

lines.zh: 我站着，手里还拿着抹布。
lines.en: I stand still with a rag in my hand.

lines.zh: 我望着门外发了一会儿呆。
lines.en: I stare out the door for a while.
The pot is not ready yet.

lines.zh: 我把围裙的带子重新系了一次。
lines.en: I retie my apron strings.
I sigh, very softly.

lines.zh: 我把桌上的碗摆成一排。
lines.en: I line the bowls up on the table.
I am deciding what to cook.

lines.zh: 我靠着门框歇了一会儿。
lines.en: I lean on the doorframe to rest.
I glance at the sky.

lines.zh: 手里的事做完了，我就站着。
lines.en: My work is done, so I just stand.
I wipe the table one more time.
I gather my hair back.
It is too quiet outside.
You are here.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，手上还湿着。
lines.en: I look up at you with wet hands.
If you have business, say it; do not just stand there.
Are you here for Gohan?
I set my work down.

lines.zh: 你看上去不像来吃饭的。
lines.en: You do not look like you came to eat.
Sit down and I will pour you water.
You smell of dust.
You are not the one I was waiting for.
I give you a quick look over.
Mind your manners.

lines.zh: 你在我家门口站多久了？
lines.en: How long have you stood at my door?
Do you remember what happened that day?
I recognize the ki on you.
Do not rush; take your time.

lines.zh: 我把手在围裙上擦干了。
lines.en: I dry my hands on my apron.
Ouch.
I stagger back and catch the wall.
What is this?
My arm is bruised.
I catch my breath.
How could you raise a hand.
My hem is torn.
I stare at you.
This is outrageous.
If you are hungry, sit at the table.
I am not short of a little food.
Take it back and eat it yourself.
I make this all the time.
I look, and it is not fresh.
Do not trade food for words.
I smile and do not take it.
I have a pot of it at home.
Keep it for the road.
Let me ask you something first.
Hey, watch yourself.
You bumped into me.

lines.zh: 我手里的东西差点撒了。
lines.en: I nearly spilled what I was carrying.
I step aside a little.
Do you not look where you walk?
I catch the doorframe.
We bump, and neither is hurt.
I brush the dust off.
Do not crowd the doorway.
Easy, no hurry.

lines.zh: 我这一辈子就在这院子过。
lines.en: I have spent my whole life in this yard.
Someone is waiting for me at home.
I keep the meal warm in the pot.

lines.zh: 日子就是这样一天天过。
lines.en: The days pass like this, one by one.
I glance at the roof.

lines.zh: 这间屋子是我一手收拾的。
lines.en: I fixed up this house myself.
I do not talk about such things.
I have to check on the child.
I sit back down in the chair.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起来，吹了吹灰。
lines.en: I bend, pick it up, and blow off the dust.
Who left this here?
I set it on the shelf.
It would break on the floor.
I take a look, then put it away.
I can use this.
I wrap it in cloth.
The table is a mess; let me tidy it.
This does not belong here.
I set it down gently.
What did you say?
I set the bowl down.
There is nothing for us to fight over.
You mean to fight?

lines.zh: 你走近了，我放下手里的活。
lines.en: You came close, I set down my work.
Do not make a scene indoors.
I eye the doorway for a way out.
You frightened me.
I cannot fight.
I will call for someone.
I hide behind the door.
Are you still here?
I put a chair in front of me.
This is no way to talk.
I step back.
Do not raise your hand like that.
I grip the edge of my apron.
I stay quiet lest you grow angrier.
I glance at the window.
It is getting dark.
I slap your hand away.
I block with the broom handle.
Do not touch my things.
I shove you once.
I shout.
I back up and hit the table.
A bowl shatters.
I am no match for you.
Why must you do this?
I am panting and my hands shake.

lines.zh: 我在门口站着，等谁回来。
lines.en: I stand at the door, waiting for someone.
Someone came to this house today.
I lit the lamp.
I hear footsteps.
I look up toward the door.
We do not often have guests here.
The pot just went on the stove.
I push the door curtain half open.
The wind pushes the door ajar.
I stand in the yard.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的袖子，我赶紧扑灭。
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve and I beat it out.
I fall off the steps.
I cannot swim; I claw at the water.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进墙里，擦过我。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the wall beside me.

lines.zh: 一阵光打过来，我站都站不稳。
lines.en: A flash of light hits and I can barely stand.

lines.zh: 我一天没吃东西，腿发软。
lines.en: I have not eaten all day and my legs are weak.
The thunder is too close and I cover my ears.

lines.zh: 我抱着的篮子，掉进虚空里了。
lines.en: The basket I was holding fell into the void.
